cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've boxed my desk things like you. Congratulations on the promotion. You make moving up look wonderfully simple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm packing because I get the corner office. You still work here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, making room for you. How lovely to get a door between yourself and the rest of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Leave your things out. I'll ask them to give you my bigger desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. More room for my next unsuccessful application.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies packing as moving up and praises ease; A3 masks the corrected office move as clearing space while praising separation; A5 praises B4 desk gift as accommodation for A's future failure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 private office supplies A3 separating door; B4 desk offer supplies A5 space for unsuccessful applications.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers furniture and asks A to stop unnecessary packing, a practical conciliatory act.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 help into evidence that one colleague advances while the other keeps failing.

specificity.evidence: A1 packed desks, B2 corner office and B4 larger desk anchor each new comparison.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 and A5 now name actual benefits rather than awkward box metaphors or a drawer doing the applying.
